Experiments with a cable
problems.problem:
Problem 2: Experiments with a cable

(10 points)

Dan, Dora and Diana set out to study the behaviour of a homogeneous, inextensible, thin and perfectly flexible cable, of length $L$ and mass $m$, in various situations.

a) Dan places the cable on a horizontal table, oriented perpendicular to the edge of the table, and lets longer and longer portions of the cable hang vertically (fig.2a1). He observes that for lengths of the hanging portion greater than $\frac{L}{5}$, when released, the cable falls off the table.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-1-2-fig1.png

[Label in the figure: masă = table.]

Dora ties an ideal string to one end, $A$, of the cable, places the whole cable on the table, oriented perpendicular to the edge of the table, and mounts an ideal pulley at the edge of the table. She passes the ideal string over the pulley and hangs a body of mass $M=m$ from the other end of the string (fig. 2a2).

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-1-2-fig2.png

Determine the acceleration of the cable and the tension in the cable at a point located at a distance $x$ $(x<L)$ from the end A, after the motion has started (and the end A has not yet reached the pulley).

b) Diana uses a detachable part of the table, which she mounts at its edge, in a position inclined to the horizontal at the angle $\alpha\cong37^\circ$ $(\cos\alpha=0.8)$. The two surfaces are made of the same material and have the same degree of polish, and the length of the inclined surface is $l=2L$.

Dan places the cable in a position perpendicular to the common edge of the two surfaces, such that the portion of the cable lying on the inclined surface has the maximum length for which the cable is in equilibrium (fig.2b). The coefficient of static friction is equal to that of sliding friction. When the table is tapped lightly, the cable starts to slide from rest. At the instant it leaves the inclined surface, the cable is in a vertical position and does not touch the floor. Determine the speed of the cable at this instant.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-1-2-fig3.png

c) Dora holds the end A of the cable at the height $h=L$, so that the cable is vertical and the other end of the cable touches the floor. She releases the upper end of the cable. During the fall, the portion of the cable that is in motion remains vertical (fig 2.c). Determine the force with which the cable presses on the floor at an instant when the upper end A is at a distance $y$ from its initial position. Air friction and the height of the pile of cable on the ground are neglected.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-1-2-fig4.png
problems.problem_orig:
Problema 2: Experimente cu cablu

(10 puncte)

Dan, Dora și Diana își propun să studieze comportarea unui cablu omogen, inextensibil, subțire și perfect flexibil, de lungime $L$ și masă $m$ în diferite situații.

a) Dan așază cablul pe o masă orizontală, orientat perpendicular pe marginea mesei și lasă să atârne vertical porțiuni din ce în ce mai lungi ale cablului (fig.2a1). El observă că pentru lungimi ale porțiunii atârnate mai mari decât $\frac{L}{5}$, lăsat liber, cablul cade de pe masă.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-1-2-fig1.png

[Etichetă în figură: masă.]

Dora leagă la un capăt, $A$, al cablului un fir ideal, așază cablul integral pe masă orientat perpendicular pe marginea mesei și montează un scripete ideal la marginea mesei. Ea trece firul ideal peste scripete și atârnă la celălalt capăt al firului un corp cu masa $M=m$ (fig. 2a2).

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-1-2-fig2.png

Determinați accelerația cablului și tensiunea în cablu într-un punct aflat la distanța $x$ $(x<L)$ de capătul A, după începerea mișcării (iar capătul A nu a ajuns încă la scripete).

b) Diana utilizează o parte detașabilă a mesei pe care o montează la marginea acesteia, într-o poziție înclinată față de orizontală cu unghiul $\alpha\cong37^\circ$ $(\cos\alpha=0{,}8)$. Cele două suprafețe sunt realizate din același material și au același grad de șlefuire iar lungimea suprafeței înclinate este $l=2L$.

Dan așază cablul într-o poziție perpendiculară pe muchia comună a celor două suprafețe astfel încât porțiunea de cablu situată pe suprafața înclinată să aibă lungimea maximă pentru care cablul este în echilibru (fig.2b). Coeficientul de frecare static este egal cu cel la alunecare. Lovind ușor masa, cablul începe să alunece pornind din repaus. În momentul părăsirii suprafeței înclinate cablul este în poziție verticală și nu atinge podeaua. Determinați viteza cablului în acest moment.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-1-2-fig3.png

c) Dora ține capătul A al cablului la înălțimea $h=L$ astfel încât cablul este vertical iar celălalt capăt al cablului atinge podeaua. Ea eliberează capătul superior al cablului. În timpul căderii porțiunea de cablu aflată în mișcare rămâne verticală (fig 2.c). Determinați forța cu care cablul apasă asupra podelei într-un moment în care capătul superior A se află la o distanță $y$ față de poziția inițială. Se neglijează frecarea cu aerul și înălțimea acumulării de cablu de pe sol.

problems.title: Equilibrium of a non-homogeneous rod
problems.problem:
Problem 3: Equilibrium of a non-homogeneous rod

(10 points)

A thin, non-uniform rod of length $AB=7d$ has its centre of gravity at a point $G$, where $AG=3d$. The rod is hung from a smooth nail P by means of an ideal, inextensible string, attached at end A and at end B of the rod. The rod hangs freely in equilibrium, in a vertical plane, in air. In the equilibrium position, at end B, the string makes with the rod the angle $\beta\cong37^\circ$ $(\cos\beta=0.8)$, as in the figure alongside.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-1-3-fig1.png

a) Calculate the size of the angle $\sphericalangle APB$.

b) Determine the value of the ratio of the tension in the string to the weight of the rod.

c) The string is removed, and the rod is placed inside a circular metal profile, with centre O, lying in a vertical plane, as in the figure alongside. The rod can slide on the metal profile such that the two ends A and B are permanently in contact with the profile, and the angle $\sphericalangle AOB=90^\circ$. The coefficient of sliding friction between the ends of the rod and the circular profile is $\mu$. The rod is in equilibrium, on the verge of sliding, at both ends. The coefficient of static friction is equal to that of sliding friction.

Determine, as a function of the coefficient of friction, the expression for the tangent of the angle $\theta$ $(0^\circ<\theta<45^\circ)$ formed by the radius $AO$ and the vertical.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-1-3-fig2.png

In solving the problems you may use the relations:

$$\cos(a\pm b)=\cos a\cos b\mp\sin a\sin b;$$

$$\sin(a\pm b)=\sin a\cos b\pm\cos a\sin b;$$

$$\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$$

Problema 3: Echilibrul unei bare neomogene

(10 puncte)

O bară subțire, neuniformă, cu lungimea $AB=7d$ are centrul de greutate într-un punct $G$, unde $AG=3d$. Bara este atârnată într-un cui neted P prin intermediul unui fir ideal, inextensibil, prins în capătul A al barei, respectiv în capătul B. Bara atârnă liber în echilibru, în plan vertical, în aer. În poziția de echilibru, în capătul B, firul formează cu bara unghiul $\beta\cong37^\circ$ $(\cos\beta=0{,}8)$, ca în figura alăturată.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-1-3-fig1.png

a) Calculați mărimea unghiului $\sphericalangle APB$.

b) Determinați valoarea raportului dintre tensiunea în fir și greutatea barei.

c) Se îndepărtează firul, iar bara este plasată în interiorul unui profil metalic circular, cu centrul în O, aflat în plan vertical, ca în figura alăturată. Bara poate culisa pe profilul metalic astfel încât cele două capete A și B sunt permanent în contact cu profilul, iar unghiul $\sphericalangle AOB=90^\circ$. Coeficientul de frecare la alunecare dintre capetele barei și profilul circular este $\mu$. Tija este în echilibru, la limita de alunecare, la ambele capete. Coeficientul de frecare static este egal cu cel la alunecare.

Determinați, în funcție de coeficientul de frecare, expresia tangentei unghiului $\theta$ $(0^\circ<\theta<45^\circ)$ format raza $AO$ și verticală.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-1-3-fig2.png

În rezolvarea subiectelor puteți utiliza relațiile:

$$\cos(a\pm b)=\cos a\cos b\mp\sin a\sin b;$$

$$\sin(a\pm b)=\sin a\cos b\pm\cos a\sin b;$$

$$\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$$

problems.title: Lenses and plates
problems.problem:
Problem 1: Lenses and plates

(10 points)

A. Lenses (5p)

Two thin spherical lenses $\mathrm{L_1}$ and $\mathrm{L_2}$, biconvex, symmetric, have identical dimensions but are made of different materials. If an afocal system is made from the two coaxial lenses, in the order $\mathrm{L_1}$ - $\mathrm{L_2}$, it enlarges, by a factor $|\beta|=3$, the diameter of a beam of rays parallel to the principal optical axis (aop).

With the two lenses a coaxial system of lenses in contact is made. A pencil placed perpendicular to the aop is brought towards the system of lenses with the constant speed $v=20\,\mathrm{mm/s}$.

a. Derive the expression for the speed of the image of the pencil $u$, as a function of the speed of the object $v$ and of the instantaneous transverse linear magnification $\beta_0$, $u=u(v,\beta_0)$;

b. Express the focal length of the system of the two lenses in contact $F_0$, as a function of the focal length of the first lens $f_{01}$ and of the magnification of the afocal system $\beta$;

c. What is the speed of the image of the pencil at the instant when it is at a distance from the system of lenses equal to twice the focal length of the first lens?

Remark: if you consider it necessary, you may use the fact that for small variations: $\Delta(x_1x_2)=x_2\Delta x_1+x_1\Delta x_2$ and $\Delta(ax)=a\Delta x$, where $a=ct.$

The previous lenses are immersed in glycerine. The focal length of the first lens increases by a factor $k_1=3$, and that of the second by a factor $k_2=5$. The lenses are cut along the axis of symmetry perpendicular to the aop, giving, for each, two plano-convex lenses. By sticking together the plane faces of one half of each lens, a new biconvex lens is formed.

d. What is the ratio of the convergences of such a lens placed in glycerine and in air, respectively?

B. Homogeneous and non-homogeneous plates (5p)

1. A laser ray is tangent to the lateral surface of a plate with plane parallel faces, of thickness $e=8\,\mathrm{mm}$ and constant refractive index, placed in a medium of refractive index $n_0=1.5$. The ray leaves the plate at the angle $\alpha=30^\circ$ as in fig. 1. Determine:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-1-fig1.png

a. The refractive index of the plate;

b. The coordinate $x_B$ of the point through which the ray leaves the plate.

2. A set of transparent plates, of the same thickness $e=1.20\,\mathrm{mm}$, are stuck next to one another, as in fig.2. The plates have a constant refractive index, but different from one plate to another, according to the relation $n_r=\frac{kn_0}{k-r}$, where $n_0=1.2$ is the refractive index of the medium outside the plates, $k=136$, and $r$ – the number of the plate (for example, $n_3=\frac{136n_0}{133}$). A laser ray is tangent to the surface of the first plate with plane parallel faces.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-1-fig2.png

c. Determine the expression for the variation $\Delta y_{p,p-1}$ of the $y$ coordinates of the points of incidence and of emergence, respectively, for the plate $p=16$.

3. A laser ray is tangent to the lateral surface of a plate with plane parallel faces whose refractive index varies according to the law $n(x)=\frac{n_0}{1-\frac{x}{a}}$, where $n_0=1.2$ is the refractive index of the medium outside the plate, and $a=130\,\mathrm{mm}$. The ray leaves the plate at the angle $\alpha=30^\circ$ as in fig. 3. Determine:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-1-fig3.png

d. The coordinate $x_B$ of the point B;

e. The shape of the trajectory of the light ray through the plate, and state the geometrical parameters specific to the shape deduced;

f. The thickness of the plate, $d$.

Problema 1: Lentile și lame

(10 puncte)

A. Lentile (5p)

Două lentile sferice subțiri $\mathrm{L_1}$ și $\mathrm{L_2}$, biconvexe, simetrice, au dimensiuni identice dar sunt confecționate din materiale diferite. Dacă se realizează din cele două lentile coaxiale un sistemul afocal, în ordinea $\mathrm{L_1}$ - $\mathrm{L_2}$, acesta mărește, de $|\beta|=3$ ori, diametrul unui fascicul de raze paralele cu axa optică principală (aop).

Cu cele două lentile se realizează un sistem coaxial de lentile lipite. Un creion așezat perpendicular pe aop este apropiat de sistemul de lentile cu viteza constantă $v=20\,\mathrm{mm/s}$.

a. Deduceți expresia vitezei imaginii creionului $u$, în funcție de viteza obiectului $v$ și de mărirea liniară transversală momentană $\beta_0$, $u=u(v,\beta_0)$;

b. Exprimați distanța focală a sistemului celor două lentile lipite $F_0$, în funcție de distanța focală a primei lentile $f_{01}$ și de mărirea sistemului afocal $\beta$;

c. Ce viteză are imaginea creionului în momentul în care se află față de sistemul de lentile la o distanță egală cu dublul distanței focale a primei lentile?

Observație: dacă considerați necesar vă puteți folosi de faptul că pentru variații mici: $\Delta(x_1x_2)=x_2\Delta x_1+x_1\Delta x_2$ și $\Delta(ax)=a\Delta x$, unde $a=ct.$

Se scufundă în glicerină lentilele precedente. Distanța focală a primei lentile crește de $k_1=3$ ori, iar a celei de a doua de $k_2=5$ ori. Lentilele se secționează după axa de simetrie perpendiculară pe aop, obținându-se, pentru fiecare, două lentile plan-convexe. Prin lipirea fețelor plane a câte unei jumătăți din fiecare lentilă, se formează o nouă lentilă biconvexă.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-1-fig1.png

a. Indicele de refracție al lamei;

b. Coordonata $x_B$ a punctului prin care raza părăsește lama.

Lamele au indicele de refracție constant dar, diferit de la o lamă la alta, după relația $n_r=\frac{kn_0}{k-r}$, unde $n_0=1{,}2$ este indicele de refracție al mediului exterior lamelor, $k=136$, iar $r$ – numărul lamei (de exemplu, $n_3=\frac{136n_0}{133}$). O rază laser este tangentă la suprafața primei lame cu fețe plane și paralele.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-1-fig2.png

c. Determinați expresia variației $\Delta y_{p,p-1}$, a coordonatelor $y$ ale punctelor de incidență, respectiv, emergență din lama $p=16$.

3. O rază laser este tangentă la suprafața laterală a unei lame cu fețe plane și paralele al cărei indice de refracție variază după legea $n(x)=\frac{n_0}{1-\frac{x}{a}}$, unde $n_0=1{,}2$ este indicele de refracție al mediului exterior lamei, iar $a=130\,\mathrm{mm}$. Raza părăsește lama sub unghiul $\alpha=30^\circ$ ca în fig. 3. Determinați:

problems.title: Heat engines
problems.problem:
Problem 2: Heat engines

(10 points)

One of the most common cyclic processes used in cooling systems is the Brayton cycle. Such a system uses an ideal gas with adiabatic exponent $\gamma$ subjected to a cyclic process consisting of an adiabatic compression (1-2), followed by an isobaric expansion (2-3), continued with an adiabatic expansion (3-4) and an isobaric compression (4-1) until it returns to the initial state.

We set out to study this cyclic process with a view to its use as a heat engine or, when traversed in the reverse direction, as a heat pump or as a refrigerating machine.

A. The Brayton engine (5 p)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-2-fig1.png

[Labels in the figure: Sursa caldă = hot source; $Q_\text{primit}$ = heat received; Motor termic = heat engine; $L$ = work; $Q_\text{cedat}$ = heat given up; Sursa rece = cold source.]

a) Represent the process described above in p-V coordinates;

b) Calculate the efficiency $\eta$ of this engine as a function of the adiabatic exponent of the gas used, $\gamma$, and of the ratio $\rho=\frac{p_{max}}{p_{min}}$, where $p_{max}$ and $p_{min}$ are the maximum and minimum pressures of the gas in the cyclic process.

c) Two such heat engines with efficiencies $\eta_1$ and $\eta_2$ are connected in series such that the heat given up to the cold source by the first engine is equal to the heat received by the second engine.

Write the relation between the efficiency $\eta_s$ of the system described and the efficiencies of the two engines $\eta_1$ and $\eta_2$.

B. The heat pump (2.50 p)

A measure of the performance of a heat pump is $COP_p$ (the coefficient of performance of the heat pump). It is defined as the ratio of the heat entering the enclosure to be heated to the net work done for this purpose:

$$COP_p=\frac{|Q_{cedat}|}{|L|}.$$

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-2-fig2.png

[Labels in the figure: Incinta încălzită = heated enclosure; Pompă de căldură = heat pump; Mediul exterior = external environment.]

We consider a heat pump that operates on the Brayton cycle described above, but reversed: isobaric expansion (1-4), adiabatic compression (4-3), isobaric compression (3-2) and adiabatic expansion (2-1) back to the initial state.

d) Calculate the coefficient of performance of the heat pump as a function of $\gamma$ and $\rho$.

e) Two heat pumps with coefficients of performance $COP_{p1}$ and $COP_{p2}$ are connected in series such that the heat given up by the first is taken up by the second.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-2-fig3.png

[Labels in the figure: Pompă de căldură 1, 2 = heat pump 1, 2.]

Calculate $COP_{ps}$ of the system.

C. The refrigerating machine (2.50 p)

In the case of the refrigerating machine too, $COP_f$ (the coefficient of performance of the refrigerating machine) is used. It is defined as the ratio of the heat taken from the cooled enclosure to the net work done for this purpose:

$$COP_f=\frac{Q_{primit}}{|L|}.$$

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-2-fig4.png

[Labels in the figure: Mașină frigorifică = refrigerating machine; Incinta răcită = cooled enclosure.]

f) Calculate the coefficient of performance $COP_f$ of a refrigerating machine operating on a Brayton cycle as a function of $\gamma$ and $\rho$.

g) Establish the relations between $COP_p$, $COP_f$ and $\eta$, considering that the three systems operate with the same parameters $\rho$ and $\gamma$.
problems.problem_orig:
Problema 2: Mașini termice

(10 puncte)

Una dintre cele mai întâlnite transformări ciclice utilizate în sistemele de răcire este ciclul Brayton. Un astfel de sistem folosește un gaz ideal cu exponentul adiabatic $\gamma$ supus unei transformări ciclice compusă dintr-o comprimare adiabatică (1-2), urmată de o destindere izobară (2-3) continuată cu o destindere adiabatică (3-4) și o comprimare izobară (4-1) până la revenirea în starea inițială.

Ne propunem să studiem această transformare ciclică în vederea utilizării sale ca motor termic, sau la parcurgerea acesteia în sens invers, ca pompă de căldură sau ca mașină frigorifică.

A. Motorul Brayton (5 p)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-2-fig1.png

[Etichete în figură: Sursa caldă; $Q_\text{primit}$; Motor termic; $L$; $Q_\text{cedat}$; Sursa rece.]

a) Reprezintă transformarea descrisă anterior în coordonate p-V;

b) Calculează randamentul $\eta$ al acestui motor în funcție de exponentul adiabatic al gazului utilizat, $\gamma$ și de raportul $\rho=\frac{p_{max}}{p_{min}}$, unde $p_{max}$ și $p_{min}$ sunt presiunile maximă, respectiv minimă ale gazului în procesul ciclic.

c) Două asemenea motoare termice cu randamentele $\eta_1$ și $\eta_2$ sunt legate în serie astfel încât căldura cedată sursei reci de către primul motor este egală cu căldura primită de cel de-al doilea motor.

Scrie relația dintre randamentul $\eta_s$ al sistemului descris și randamentele celor două motoare $\eta_1$ și $\eta_2$.

B. Pompa de căldură (2,50 p)

O măsură a performanței unei pompe de căldură este $COP_p$ (coeficientul de performanță al pompei de căldură). Acesta este definit ca raportul dintre căldura ce pătrunde în incinta de încălzit și lucrul mecanic net efectuat în acest scop:

$$COP_p=\frac{|Q_{cedat}|}{|L|}.$$

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-2-fig2.png

[Etichete în figură: Incinta încălzită; Pompă de căldură; Mediul exterior.]

Considerăm o pompă de căldură care funcționează după ciclul Brayton descris anterior, dar inversat: destindere izobară (1-4), comprimare adiabatică (4-3), comprimare izobară (3-2) și destindere adiabatică (2-1) până în starea inițială.

d) Calculează coeficientul de performanță al pompei de căldură în funcție de $\gamma$ și $\rho$.

e) Două pompe de căldură cu coeficienții de performanță $COP_{p1}$ și $COP_{p2}$ sunt legate în serie astfel încât căldura cedată de prima este preluată de a doua.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-2-fig3.png

[Etichete în figură: Pompă de căldură 1, 2.]

Calculează $COP_{ps}$ al sistemului.

C. Mașina frigorifică (2,50 p)

Și în cazul mașinii frigorifice se utilizează $COP_f$ (coeficientul de performanță a mașinii frigorifice). Acesta se definește ca raportul dintre căldura preluată din incinta răcită și lucrul mecanic net efectuat în acest scop:

$$COP_f=\frac{Q_{primit}}{|L|}.$$

[Etichete în figură: Mașină frigorifică; Incinta răcită.]

problems.problem:
Problem 3: Heat transfer

(10 points)

In this problem we shall analyse heat transfer by conduction. This process is described by Fourier's law:

$$I=\frac{\Delta Q}{\Delta t}=-kA\frac{\Delta T}{\Delta x},\quad(1)$$

where:

• $I$ is the intensity of the heat current,

• $\frac{\Delta Q}{\Delta t}$ is the quantity of heat that passes through a cross-section of the thermal conductor per unit time,

• $k$ is the thermal conductivity of the material,

• $A$ is the area of the cross-section

• $\Delta T$ is the temperature variation between the two cross-sections located at the distance $\Delta x$, where $\frac{\Delta T}{\Delta x}$ is the temperature gradient along the direction of propagation of the heat.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-3-fig1.png

A. (7 p)

a) A copper bar of square cross-section with side $a=10\,\mathrm{cm}$ and length $l=20\,\mathrm{cm}$ connects two thermal reservoirs. The first reservoir is kept at $T_1=100\,^\circ\mathrm{C}$, and the second contains water with ice at $T_2=0\,^\circ\mathrm{C}$. After the steady flow has been established, calculate the time interval in which a mass $m=100\,\mathrm{g}$ of ice melts. (Given: the thermal conductivity of copper $k_{Cu}\cong400\,\frac{\mathrm{W}}{\mathrm{m\cdot K}}$ and the specific latent heat of ice $\lambda_\text{gheață}\cong34\cdot10^{4}\,\frac{\mathrm{J}}{\mathrm{kg}}$).

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-3-fig2.png

b) Relation (1) can be written in the form: $|\Delta T|=I\frac{|\Delta x|}{k\cdot A}=I\cdot R$ where $R$ is the thermal resistance. Calculate the thermal resistance of the bar described in the previous part.

c) The connection between the reservoirs at temperatures $T_1$ and $T_2$ is made by means of two bars, the one described above and a second bar made of iron with the same geometrical dimensions. The two bars are placed one after the other (in series). Calculate the intensity of the heat current through the system of bars, the temperature of the interface between them and the equivalent thermal resistance (Given $k_{Fe}\cong80\,\frac{\mathrm{W}}{\mathrm{m\cdot K}}$.).

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-3-fig3.png

d) The two bars that connect the reservoirs are placed in parallel. Calculate the intensity of the heat current through the system of bars and the equivalent thermal resistance.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-2-3-fig4.png

B. (3 p)

Through a very long cylindrical conductor of radius $R$ and thermal conductivity $k$ flows an electric current which causes a release of heat $q$ per unit volume and unit time, constant.

The temperature of the outer surface of the conductor is kept at the value $T_0$.

Establish the relation for the dependence of the temperature $T(r)$ on the distance $r$ from the middle of the conductor.

Calculate the value of the temperature in the middle of the conductor.

III.A. ... Damped mechanical oscillations (4 points)

Under the action of a resistance force proportional to the velocity, a body acted on by an elastic-type force can, under certain conditions, perform damped oscillations. The solution of the equation of motion for this body is: $x(t)=A(t)\cdot\cos(\omega t+\varphi_0)$, where the amplitude of these oscillations changes in time according to the law $A(t)=A_0\cdot e^{-\delta\cdot t}$. In the relations above $\delta$ is a constant called the damping coefficient, and $\omega=\sqrt{\omega_0^2-\delta^2}$ is the angular frequency of the damped oscillator ($\omega_0$ being the natural angular frequency of the oscillator).

a) Show that the velocity of the body is $\mathrm{v}(t)=\alpha\cdot e^{-\delta\cdot t}\cdot\sin(\omega\cdot t+\varphi_0+\beta)$ and determine the expressions of the constants $\alpha$ and $\beta$.

b) The dimensionless physical quantity that characterises the performance of an oscillator is called the quality factor. It is defined as the ratio of the total mechanical energy of the oscillator to the energy dissipated per radian:

$$Q=\frac{E(t)}{E_{dis.}/rad}=\frac{E(t)}{E_{dis.,T}/2\pi},$$

$E_{dis.,T}$ being the energy dissipated in a time of one period. Calculate the quality factor of the damped oscillator as a function of the period of the damped oscillator $T$ and of the damping coefficient $\delta$.

Problem 1: Acoustic membranes ...

(10 points)

Sound-absorbing structures can be used to insulate rooms against noise (unpleasant audible sounds). The choice of the sound-absorbing structure is made taking into account the dependence of the absorption coefficient on the frequency of the sound source. The absorption coefficient, $\alpha$, is given by the relation:

$$\alpha=1-\frac{E_r}{E_i}$$

where $E_r$ is the energy of the reflected wave, and $E_i$ is the energy of the incident wave.

Each sound-absorbing structure has a natural frequency. If the natural frequency of the sound-absorbing structure is equal to the frequency of the sound wave, then the phenomenon of resonance occurs, i.e. the sound-absorbing structure absorbs a maximum acoustic energy $(\alpha\to1)$.

For sound insulation in the case of acoustic waves of low frequencies, acoustic membranes having the shape shown in the drawing Figure 1.1 are used.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-4-1-fig1.png

Figure 1.1

[Labels in the figure: Perete = wall; Distanțier = spacer; Membrană = membrane; Aer = air.]

The membrane in Figure 1.1 is attached a few centimetres from the wall by means of spacers, and in that cavity there is air. This device is considered to be a mechanical oscillator (see the drawing in Figure 1.2) in which $M$ is the mass of the membrane, and $k$ is the equivalent elastic constant (stiffness).

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-4-1-fig2.png

Figure 1.2

As a result of the interaction of the sound-absorbing structure with the acoustic wave, the air inside the cavity undergoes an adiabatic process.

The following quantities are considered known:

• the mass of the membrane $M=1.50\,\mathrm{kg}$;

• the area of the membrane $S=1.50\,\mathrm{m^2}$;

• the distance from the wall $D=0.10\,\mathrm{m}$;

• the density of the air in the cavity $\rho_0=1.30\,\mathrm{kg/m^3}$;

• the speed of propagation of the sound wave in air $c=340.00\,\mathrm{m/s}$.

a. Show that the force acting on the oscillator is of elastic type. Calculate the equivalent elastic constant of the oscillator.

b. Derive the dynamical equation of the oscillator. Calculate the natural frequency of the oscillator.

c. The experimental values of the natural frequency for the acoustic membrane are smaller than those obtained theoretically, because part of the air in the cavity is also set in motion in the oscillatory motion. Determine what fraction of the mass of the air is approximated as being set in motion, so that the frequency obtained by calculation corresponds to the one obtained experimentally, justifying your answer.

Remark: If you need it, take the following into account:

• The speed of propagation of sound in air is:

$$c=\sqrt{\frac{p_0\gamma}{\rho_0}}$$

where $\gamma$ is the adiabatic exponent of the air in the cavity, and $p_0$ is the atmospheric pressure.

• You may use the relation:

$$(1+y)^n=1+ny,\ \text{for}\ |y|\ll1.$$

Problema 1: Membrane acustice ...

(10 puncte)

Structurile fonoabsorbante se pot utiliza pentru izolarea încăperilor împotriva zgomotelor (sunete neplăcut audibile). Alegerea structurii fonoabsorbante se face având în vedere dependența dintre coeficientul de absorbție și frecvența sursei sonore. Coeficientul de absorbție, $\alpha$, este dat de relația:

$$\alpha=1-\frac{E_r}{E_i}$$

unde $E_r$ este energia undei reflectate, iar $E_i$ reprezintă energia undei incidente.

Fiecare structură fonoabsorbantă are o frecvență proprie. Dacă frecvența proprie a structurii fonoabsorbante este egală cu frecvența undei sonore, atunci are loc fenomenul de rezonanță, adică structura fonoabsorbantă absoarbe o energie acustică maximă $(\alpha\to1)$.

Pentru izolare fonică în cazul undelor acustice cu frecvențe joase se folosesc membrane acustice ce au forma reprezentată în desenul Figura 1.1.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-4-1-fig1.png

Figura 1.1

[Etichete în figură: Perete; Distanțier; Membrană; Aer.]

Membrana din Figura 1.1 se atașează la câțiva centimetri de perete prin intermediul unor distanțieri, iar în acea cavitate există aer. Acest dispozitiv este considerat a fi un oscilator mecanic (vezi desenul din Figura 1.2) în care $M$ reprezintă masa membranei, iar $k$ este constanta elastică (rigiditatea) echivalentă.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2022-4-1-fig2.png

Figura 1.2

În urma interacției structurii fonoabsorbante cu unda acustică aerul din interiorul cavității suferă un proces adiabatic.

Se consideră cunoscute următoarele mărimi:

• masa membranei $M=1{,}50\,\mathrm{kg}$;

• suprafața membranei $S=1{,}50\,\mathrm{m^2}$;

• distanța față de perete $D=0{,}10\,\mathrm{m}$;

• densitatea aerului din cavitate $\rho_0=1{,}30\,\mathrm{kg/m^3}$;

• viteza de propagare a undei sonore în aer $c=340{,}00\,\mathrm{m/s}$.

a. Să se arate că forța ce acționează asupra oscilatorului este de tip elastic. Să se calculeze constanta elastică echivalentă a oscilatorului.

b. Să se deducă ecuația dinamică a oscilatorului. Să se calculeze frecvența proprie a oscilatorului.

c. Valorile experimentale ale frecvenței proprii, pentru membrana acustică sunt mai mici decât cele obținute pe cale teoretică, deoarece în mișcarea oscilatorie este antrenată și o parte din aerul din cavitate. Să se determine cât din masa aerului se aproximează, că ar fi pusă în mișcare, pentru ca frecvența obținută prin calcul, să corespundă cu cea obținută experimental, justificând răspunsul.

Observație: Dacă îți este necesar ține seama de următoarele:

• Viteza de propagare a sunetului în aer este:

$$c=\sqrt{\frac{p_0\gamma}{\rho_0}}$$

unde $\gamma$ este exponentul adiabatic al aerului din cavitate, iar $p_0$ este presiunea atmosferică.

• Poți folosi relația:

$$(1+y)^n=1+ny,\ \text{pentru}\ |y|\ll1.$$

$$\vec E_1=\frac{1-\beta_1^2}{\left(1-\beta_1^2\sin^2\theta_1\right)^{3/2}}\cdot\frac{q_1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0}\cdot\frac{\vec r_{21}}{r_{21}^3};\quad\vec B_1=\frac{\vec{\mathrm v}_1\times\vec E_1}{c^2},$$

where:

$$\theta_1=\angle\left(\vec{\mathrm v}_1;\vec r_{21}\right).$$

Determine the components of the forces $\vec F_1$ and $\vec F_2$ respectively, components directed along the axes OX and OY respectively, resulting from the interaction of the two charged particles, which, at the instant considered, act on them, expressing them as functions of: $r_{21}$, $q_1$, $q_2$, $\varepsilon_0$, $\beta_1$, $\beta_2$.

b.2. Interpret the result obtained in the previous part, (b.1), from the point of view of the principle of reciprocal actions, in accordance with STR. Particular case: $\beta_1\ll1$; $\beta_2\ll1$.

b.3. Justify the result obtained, regarding the validity of the principle of reciprocal actions, in accordance with STR.

Problem 3: Particles in motion ...

(10 points)

Two particles P1 and P2 each have rest mass $m_0$. The particles P1 and P2 enter with the speeds $v_{01}$ and $v_{02}$ a potential field with central symmetry. The potential energy of the particle – field interaction, for each particle, is given by the relation $U(r)=-k_1/r^{k_2}$, where $k_1\neq0$ and $k_2>0$. The speed of light in vacuum is taken as $c=3.00\cdot10^{8}\,\mathrm{m/s}$, and $\hbar$ is the reduced Planck constant.

a. At a given instant the de Broglie wavelength associated with particle P1 is equal to the Compton wavelength corresponding to the same particle.

a.1. Calculate the speed of particle P1 in this case.

a.2. State by what percentage the rest energy of particle P1 is greater than its kinetic energy.

b. Suppose that particle P2 moves on a circular orbit of radius $R$. Consider $k_1>0$.

b.1. Derive the expression for the magnitude of the angular momentum of particle P2 as a function of the speed $v_{02}$ of the particle, the radius $R$ and the constants $k_1$ and $k_2$ respectively.

b.2. Derive the expression for the radius of the orbit. Express the result as a function of the constants $k_1$ and $k_2$, the mass $m_0$ and the speed $v_{02}$, as well as the speed of light in vacuum, $c$. Particularise the result for the non-relativistic case $(v_{02}\ll c)$.

b.3. Consider that the magnitude of the angular momentum of particle P2 is given by the relation $L=2k_1/c$. Determine the radius of the circular orbit as a function of the speed $v_{02}$, the constant $k_2$ and the speed of light in vacuum, $c$.

c. Determine the ionisation energy of an "atom", for $k_1>0$, when particle P2 moves non-relativistically in the field of the nucleus of that "atom". Express the result as a function of the constants $k_1$ and $k_2$, the mass $m_0$ and the reduced Planck constant, $\hbar$.

Remark: If you need it, take the following into account:

• In the study of the rotational motion of a particle about a point, instead of the momentum, $\vec p$, its moment about that point is used; the angular momentum is:

$$\vec L=\vec r\times\vec p,$$

where $\vec r$ is the position vector of the particle.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2023-1-3-fig1.png

On touching each rod the grasshopper loses all the mechanical energy developed at the launch. The interaction of the grasshopper with the air is neglected.

a. Compare the mechanical work done by the grasshopper in crossing the brook in the two cases, justifying your answer.

b. Calculate the ratio of the times taken to cross from one bank to the other in the two cases. The times spent by the grasshopper on the tops of the rods during the jumps are neglected.

B. Sun, Earth... and satellites

In an orbital configuration formed by two massive bodies there are positions, located on the line joining their centres, at which a small-mass object, affected only by gravity, is at rest relative to the two bodies. In the Sun–Earth system, a satellite of the Sun placed at one of these positions is considered to have an orbital angular velocity equal to the orbital angular velocity of the Earth. The following physical quantities are known: the universal gravitational constant $K$, the distance between the centre of the Sun and the centre of the Earth $D$, the mass of the Sun $M_1$, the mass of the Earth $M_2$ and the radius of the Earth $R$. The Earth's orbit is taken to be circular. Air resistance and the rotation of the Earth about its own axis are neglected.

Numerical values: $K=6.67\cdot10^{-11}\,\mathrm{N\,m^2/kg^2}$, $D=1.5\cdot10^{8}\,\mathrm{km}$, $M_1=2\cdot10^{30}\,\mathrm{kg}$, $M_2=6\cdot10^{24}\,\mathrm{kg}$, $R=6400\,\mathrm{km}$.

a. Calculate the distance from the centre of the Earth to each of the positions in the vicinity of the Earth at which the orbital angular velocity of the satellite equals the orbital angular velocity of the Earth. You may use the approximation $(1\pm x)^n\simeq1\pm nx$ for $x\ll1$.

b. Calculate the magnitude of the velocity with which a body must be launched from the surface of the Earth in order to move on a circular orbit at height $h$ above the ground. The gravitational influence of the Sun is neglected.

Numerical value: $h=600\,\mathrm{km}$.

c. Calculate the magnitude of the minimum velocity needed by a body launched from the surface of the Earth in order to leave the gravitational field of the Earth. The gravitational influence of the Sun is neglected.

(10 puncte)

A. Lăcusta... săritoare

Într-un pârâu, pe direcție perpendiculară pe mal, sunt așezate echidistant un număr impar de baghete cu înălțimi egale, în poziție verticală, conform figurii alăturate. This problem asks you to analyse the evolution of a system of bodies in three distinct situations.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2023-2-1-fig1.png

I. On a drum of negligible mass and radius $R$, which can rotate without friction about a horizontal axis, a string of negligible mass is wound; one end of the string is fixed to the lateral surface of the drum. A small bag of sand of mass $M$ is tied to the other end of the string. Four spokes of negligible mass, each of length $l$, are mounted on the drum, with very small balls of mass $m$ each fixed at their ends. The directions of the spokes lie in a plane perpendicular to the axle of the drum and pass through the centre of the circular cross-section of the drum in this plane. Any two neighbouring spokes are perpendicular, as in the figure alongside.

The system is left to evolve freely, starting from rest from the position in which the bag is at height $h_0$ above the ground and the portion of string between the drum and the bag is vertical. The interaction with the air is neglected, and the gravitational acceleration $g$ of the Earth at ground level is considered known.

1.a. Determine the mathematical expression of the speed of the bag immediately before it touches the ground, in terms of the data given in the statement. (2.0 p)

After the bag reaches the ground, the drum continues to rotate; the string unwinds and then rewinds.

1.b. Derive the mathematical expression of the height $h_1$ to which the bag will be raised as a result of the rewinding of the string, in terms of the data given in the statement. (2.0 p)

1.c. If the process continues through successive rewindings, determine the number $n$ of times the bag touches the ground after which the system will remain at rest. (2.0 p)

II. Consider a new situation in which the system of bodies remains the same, except for the drum, which is replaced by a hollow cylinder without bases, with a very thin lateral surface and mass $m_0$ uniformly distributed. The system is left to evolve freely, starting from rest from the position in which the bag is at height $h_0$ above the ground and the portion of string between the drum and the bag is vertical.

1.d. Derive the expression of the height $h_1^A$ to which the bag will be raised under these new conditions as a result of the first rewinding of the string, in terms of the data given in the statement. (2.0 p)

problems.title: The freezing of the water in a freshwater lake
problems.problem:
Problem 2: The freezing of the water in a freshwater lake

(10 points)

The process of cooling and subsequent freezing of the water in a freshwater lake is significantly influenced by the variation of the density of water with its temperature in the vicinity of low temperatures, close to $0^\circ C$, the density of water being maximum at the temperature of $4^\circ C$.

The water at the surface of the lake is in contact with the cold air and gives off heat to the ambient air.

While the water cools from higher temperatures towards the temperature of $4^\circ C$, its density increases. As a result, the water at the surface of the lake, being already cooled and having a greater density than the water in the lower layers, sinks and is replaced by the warmer water from the depths, which rises, having a smaller density and being lighter than the water at the surface. This phenomenon slowly equalises the temperature of the water in the whole lake, so that, as long as the temperature of the water at the surface of the lake is higher than $4^\circ C$, the lake cools throughout its whole volume.

The cooling process continues, but as soon as the temperature of the water at the surface of the lake falls below $4^\circ C$ its density starts to decrease, so that the water in the upper layers, being less dense and therefore lighter than the water in the depths, remains at the surface of the lake and cools down to the temperature of $0^\circ C$. Subsequently the water at the surface of the lake freezes, first as a fine thin film, and then the ice layer thickens. During the freezing, the rest of the water in the lake remains at a temperature of $4^\circ C$ and underwater life is possible.

During the process of ice formation in a freshwater lake, the air above the lake is considered a thermostat; its temperature is constant and has the value $t=-20^\circ C$; the temperature of the water located immediately below the ice layer remains constant and has the value $t_0=0^\circ C$; and at the beginning of the freezing process there is no ice layer on the surface of the lake. The process of ice formation takes place only through the heat exchange between the water of the lake and the air above it.

Consider known:

• the specific latent heat of solidification of water $\lambda_g=334\,KJ/Kg$;
• the density of ice $\rho_g=900\,Kg/m^3$;
• the thermal conductivity coefficient of ice $k_g=2.2\,W/(m\cdot K)$, the quantity of heat passing per unit time through an ice layer of thickness $1\,m$ and area $1\,m^2$ for a temperature difference of $1^\circ C$ between its two faces.

2.a. Determine the mathematical expression giving the dependence of the thickness $x$ of the ice layer formed at the surface of the lake on the temperature difference between the faces of the ice layer and on the duration of the freezing process. (4.5 p)

2.b. Calculate the thickness of the ice layer formed during $\tau=10\,hours$ of freezing. (1.0 p)

2.c. Calculate the number of consecutive days of frost at the temperature $t=-20^\circ C$ needed for the thickness of the ice layer to reach $50.3\,cm$. (1.5 p)

2.d. Explain and justify, on the basis of the relation obtained in part 2.a., why, in general, in regions with a temperate climate, deep freshwater lakes, with depths of at least $2\,m$, freeze only at the surface and not throughout their whole volume. (3.0 p)

Note: For a very small variation $\Delta x$ of the quantity $x$, you may use the relation: $\Delta\left(x^2\right)\cong2\cdot x\cdot\Delta x$

Problema 2: Înghetul apei dintr-un lac cu apă dulce

(10 puncte)

Procesul de răcire și ulterior de îngheț al apei dintr-un lac cu apă dulce este influențat semnificativ de variația densității apei în funcție de temperatura acesteia în vecinătatea temperaturilor mici, apropiate de $0^\circ C$, densitatea apei fiind maximă la temperatura de $4^\circ C$.

Apa de la suprafața lacului este în contact cu aerul rece și cedează căldură aerului ambiant.

Pe timpul răcirii apei de la temperaturi mai mari spre temperatura de $4^\circ C$, densitatea acesteia crește. Ca urmare, apa de la suprafața lacului, fiind deja răcită și având densitatea mai mare decât apa din straturile inferioare, coboară și este înlocuită cu apa mai caldă din adâncuri, care urcă având densitatea mai mică, fiind mai ușoară decât cea de la suprafață. Acest fenomen egalizează lent temperatura apei din întregul lac astfel că, atât timp cât temperatura apei de la suprafața lacului este mai mare de $4^\circ C$, lacul se răcește în totalitatea volumului acestuia.

Procesul de răcire continuă, dar imediat ce temperatura apei de la suprafața lacului scade sub $4^\circ C$ densitatea acesteia începe să scadă, astfel că apa din straturile superioare fiind mai puțin densă și deci mai ușoară decât cea din adâncuri, rămâne la suprafața lacului și se răcește până la temperatura de $0^\circ C$. Ulterior apa de la suprafața lacului îngheață, mai întâi ca o pojghiță fină, apoi stratul de gheață se îngroașă. Pe timpul înghețului, restul apei din lac rămâne la o temperatură de $4^\circ C$ și viața subacvatică este posibilă.

Pe parcursul procesului de formare a gheții într-un lac cu apă dulce, aerul de deasupra lacului este considerat un termostat, temperatura lui este constantă și are valoarea $t=-20^\circ C$, temperatura apei situată imediat sub stratul de gheață rămâne constantă și are valoarea $t_0=0^\circ C$, iar la începutul procesului de îngheț nu există strat de gheață pe suprafața lacului. Procesul de formare a gheții are loc doar pe baza schimbului de căldură dintre apa lacului și aerul de deasupra acestuia.

Considerați cunoscute:

• căldura latentă specifică de solidificare a apei $\lambda_g=334\,KJ/Kg$;
• densitatea gheții $\rho_g=900\,Kg/m^3$;
• coeficientul de conductivitate termică a gheții $k_g=2{,}2\,W/(m\cdot K)$, cantitatea de căldură ce trece în unitatea de timp printr-un strat de gheață cu grosimea de $1\,m$, cu suprafața de $1\,m^2$, la o diferență de temperatura de $1^\circ C$ între cele două fețe ale sale.

2.a. Determinați expresia matematică ce redă dependența grosimii $x$ a stratului de gheață formată la suprafața lacului în funcție de diferența de temperatură dintre fețele stratului de gheață și de durata procesului de îngheț. (4,5p)

2.d. Explicați și justificați, pe baza relației obținute la punctul 2.a., de ce, în general, în regiunile cu un climat temperat, lacurile adânci cu apă dulce, cu adâncimi de cel puțin $2\,m$, îngheață doar la suprafață și nu în totalitatea volumului acestora. (3,0p)

Notă: Pentru o variație $\Delta x$ foarte mică a mărimii $x$, puteți lua în considerare relația: $\Delta\left(x^2\right)\cong2\cdot x\cdot\Delta x$

Problem 1

A. Two musicians tune their identical guitars, one in the concert hall, where the temperature is $t_1=25\,^\circ\mathrm{C}$, and the other in a neighbouring room, where the temperature is $t_2=15\,^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Tuning is done by tensioning the string appropriately, by winding it on the tuning peg. After tuning, by plucking the A string (La), each of the two produces a sound of frequency $\nu_1=440\,\mathrm{Hz}$. The vibrating portion of the string lies between two supports called the saddle (înălțător) and the nut (prăguș). After the second guitarist also enters the concert hall and his guitar reaches thermal equilibrium, the two simultaneously pluck the strings corresponding to the note A and find that the phenomenon of beats appears. The beat frequency is $\nu_b=3\,\mathrm{Hz}$. Neglecting the expansion of the body of the guitar and the expansion in thickness, calculate the coefficient of thermal expansion of the steel of which the string corresponding to the note A is made.

Given: the density of steel $\rho=8.0\cdot10^{3}\,\mathrm{kg/m^3}$, the constant distance between the saddle and the nut $\ell=63\,\mathrm{cm}$, Young's modulus for steel $E=2.0\cdot10^{11}\,\mathrm{N/m^2}$, and the product $\alpha\cdot t\ll1$.

B. Two very long strings are made of different materials, of densities $\rho_1$ and $\rho_2$. The strings have the same cross-section $S$ and are attached to one another, as in figure 1. A transverse wave propagates along string 1, towards the point of contact, according to the equation:

$$y_i(t,x)=A_i\sin\left[2\pi\left(\frac{t}{T}-\frac{x}{\lambda_1}\right)\right].$$

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2023-3-1-fig1.png

Figure 1

To determine the relativistic relative velocity of the point particle $\mathrm P_1$ with respect to the point particle $\mathrm P_2$, i.e. $\vec{\mathrm v}_{12,\mathrm{relativist}}$, means to determine the velocity of the point particle $\mathrm P_1$ with respect to the moving inertial frame, $\mathrm R'$, attached to the particle $\mathrm P_2$, i.e. $\vec{\mathrm v}_{12,\mathrm{relativist}}=\vec{\mathrm v}'_1$.

Also establish the relation between the magnitudes and the orientations of the vectors $\vec{\mathrm v}_{21,\mathrm{relativist}}$ and $\vec{\mathrm v}_{12,\mathrm{relativist}}$, stating whether the two vectors are identical.

Problem 3: Various collisions

(10 points)

Ivona and Nicușor, pupils in grade IX, set out to study the collision of bodies using an experimental device consisting of a projectile launcher, a platform and a small wagon, initially at rest on a horizontal surface, as in the adjacent figure.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2024-1-3-fig1.png

The projectile launcher (left of the picture) uses the elastic energy of a compressed spring, of spring constant $k = 2000\,\mathrm{N/m}$, to launch identical spherical bodies of mass $m = 0.20\,\mathrm{kg}$ each. The tube of the launcher, together with the support on which it is fixed, has mass $M_1 = 1.80\,\mathrm{kg}$ and can slide with friction on the horizontal surface, the coefficient of sliding friction being $\mu = 0.10$.

The platform of mass $M_2 = 0.40\,\mathrm{kg}$ consists of a plane, horizontal and smooth surface, $AB$, of length $\ell = 20\,\mathrm{cm}$, continued by a smooth cylindrical surface, $BC$, of radius $r = \ell/2$. At point $C$ there is placed a target body of spherical shape and of the same mass $m$ as the projectile, resting on a support in the form of a ring fixed to the platform.

The wagon of mass $m_x$, of parallelepiped shape with length $L = 20\,\mathrm{cm}$ and height $h = r$, is filled with sand (which acts as a damper) and is fitted at its ends with elastic buffers.

The running gear of the platform and of the wagon ensures that they move without friction.

To launch the projectile from point $A$, located at the end of the platform, the spring of the launcher is compressed by $\Delta l = 0.10\,\mathrm{m}$.

The gravitational acceleration is taken to be $g \cong 10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, and the work done by the friction force during the displacement of the launcher while the spring is expanding is neglected.

a) (2.8 p) Calculate the magnitude of the velocity $v_0$ of the launched projectile and the distance $d$ travelled by the launcher until it stops, measured from the moment at which the projectile leaves its guide tube.

b) (1.4 p) Justify, using quantitative energy arguments, neglecting the work done by the friction force during the displacement of the launcher while the spring is expanding.

c) (3.0 p) Determine the values of the components (horizontal and vertical, respectively) of the velocity vector with which the target placed at point $C$ detaches from the platform, after it collides perfectly inelastically with the projectile launched from point $A$ (the radius of the projectile is smaller than the radius of the ring used to support the target body).

At the instant immediately following the one at which the target body placed at point $C$ has undergone the perfectly inelastic collision with the projectile, the platform collides perfectly elastically with the wagon, which is at rest, so that the wagon starts to move.

d) (1.6 p) Determine the maximum and the minimum values that the mass $m_x$ of the wagon must have so that the target body, launched from point $C$ as a result of the perfectly inelastic collision with the projectile, falls into the wagon.

e) (1.2 p) Calculate the values of the velocity of the wagon immediately before and immediately after the body falls into the sand in the wagon, in the cases presented in part d).

Let us now consider that, at the time $t > 0$ indicated by the clock of the observer O in the frame R, at the point $\mathrm{A}(0; -a; 0)$, belonging to the fixed inertial frame R, an event E took place, consisting in the decay of a PION particle, which resulted in a MUON and a NEUTRINO, the latter, the NEUTRINO, being emitted along the axis OY, in its positive direction, with the velocity $\vec{\mathrm{v}}_{\mathrm{y}} = \vec{\mathrm{v}}$, for which $\mathrm{v_y} = \mathrm{v} = c$, relative to the fixed inertial frame R, as shown in the drawing in figure 1.

Each of the two observers, O and O' respectively, refers the same event E to his own reference frame, R and R' respectively, as taking place at different times, $t$ and $t'$ respectively, and they locate it, each in his own reference frame, by different position vectors, $\vec{r}$ and $\vec{r}\,'$ respectively.

$$t' = \Gamma\cdot\left(t - \frac{\vec{u}\cdot\vec{r}}{c^2}\right),$$

Corespunzător momentului când prin originea O a unui sistem inerțial fix, R, în care se află observatorul O, trece originea O' a unui sistem inerțial mobil, R', aflat în mișcare rectilinie și uniformă, cu viteza $\vec{u}$, față de sistemul R, în care se află observatorul O', așa cum indică desenul din figura 1, cei doi observatori, O și O', și-au sincronizat ceasornicele proprii, astfel încât indicațiile acestora să fie $t = t' = 0$.

Să considerăm acum că, la momentul $t > 0$, indicat de ceasornicul observatorului O, din sistemul R, în punctul $\mathrm{A}(0; -a; 0)$, aparținând sistemului inerțial fix, R, s-a produs un eveniment, E, constând în dezintegrarea unui particule PION, din care a rezultat un MIUON și un NEUTRIN, acesta din urmă, NEUTRINUL, fiind emis de-a lungul axei OY, în sensul pozitiv al acesteia, cu viteza $\vec{\mathrm{v}}_{\mathrm{y}} = \vec{\mathrm{v}}$, pentru care $\mathrm{v_y} = \mathrm{v} = c$, raportată la sistemul inerțial fix, R, așa cum indică desenul din figura 1.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2024-4-3-fig1.png

Fig. 1

Fiecare dintre cei doi observatori, O și respectiv O', raportează același eveniment, E, la sistemul său de referință, R și respectiv R', ca producându-se la momente diferite, $t$ și respectiv $t'$, și pe care ei îl localizează, fiecare în sistemul său de referință, cu vectorii de poziție diferiți, $\vec{r}$ și respectiv $\vec{r}\,'$.

a) (4,0p) Să se determine coordonatele $(x'; y'; z'; t')$ ale producerii evenimentului E, reprezentat de dezintegrarea PIONULUI, raportate la sistemul inerțial R', știind că planul axelor $(\mathrm{O'X'}; \mathrm{O'Y'})$ este același cu planul axelor $(\mathrm{OX}; \mathrm{OY})$ și că $\mathrm{O'X'} // \mathrm{OX}$, $\mathrm{O'Y'} // \mathrm{OY}$, $\mathrm{O'Z'} // \mathrm{OZ}$.

Se cunosc elementele constante ale vectorului $\vec{u}$, (modul, $u$, și orientare, $\alpha$), aflat în planul XOY, reprezentând viteza sistemului inerțial mobil, R', în raport cu sistemul inerțial fix, R.

Se cunoaște forma vectorială a transformărilor Lorentz, exprimate prin relațiile:

$$\vec{r}\,' = \vec{r} + \vec{u}\cdot\left[(\Gamma - 1)\cdot\frac{\vec{u}\cdot\vec{r}}{u^2} - \Gamma\cdot t\right];\quad \Gamma = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}};\quad \beta = \frac{u}{c};$$

$$t' = \Gamma\cdot\left(t - \frac{\vec{u}\cdot\vec{r}}{c^2}\right),$$

unde $\vec{r}$ și respectiv $\vec{r}\,'$ sunt vectorii de poziție ai punctului unde s-a produs un eveniment, E, în raport cu observatorul O din sistemul R și respectiv în raport cu observatorul O' din sistemul inerțial R'.

b) (3,0p) Să se determine componentele $(\mathrm{v}'_{x'}; \mathrm{v}'_{y'}; \mathrm{v}'_{z'})$ ale vitezei NEUTRINULUI, $\vec{\mathrm{v}}\,'$, în raport cu observatorul O' din sistemul inerțial R'.

c) (3,0p) Să se determine elementele vectorului $\vec{\mathrm{v}}\,'$, modulul $(\mathrm{v}')$, și orientarea $(\theta')$, și să se interpreteze rezultatul referitor la modulul acestuia, $\mathrm{v}'$, încadrându-l în principiile Teoriei Relativității Restrânse.

problems.title: Troublesome motions ...
problems.problem:
Problem 1: Troublesome motions ...

A. A car starts from point A, from rest, with a constant acceleration of magnitude $a_1=1\,\dfrac{\mathrm{m}}{\mathrm{s^2}}$; $\Delta t=15\,\mathrm{s}$ later, another car passes through point A, along the same line and in the same direction as the first one, with a constant velocity of magnitude $v_2=144\,\dfrac{\mathrm{km}}{\mathrm{h}}$. The motions of the cars are rectilinear.

a$_1$) In the situation described, the cars meet twice; calculate the distances $x_1$ and $x_2$ at which the cars meet and the moments of the meetings of the cars, $t_1$ and $t_2$, measured from the place and the moment of departure of the first car.

a$_2$) Determine the value of the constant speed $v_2'$ with which the second car should pass through point A ($\Delta t=15\,\mathrm{s}$ after the departure of the first car) so that the two cars meet only once.

a$_3$) Calculate the value of the constant acceleration $a_1'$ with which the first car should start from point A in order not to be caught up by the car that passes through A ($\Delta t=15\,\mathrm{s}$ after the departure of the first one) with the constant speed $v_2=144\,\dfrac{\mathrm{km}}{\mathrm{h}}$.

B. On an inclined plane of angle $\alpha=30^0$ and length $l=5\,\mathrm{m}$ there is a body (considered point-like) of mass $m=4\,\mathrm{kg}$, tied to the top of the plane by an extensible thread of cross-section $S=5\,\mathrm{cm^2}$ and undeformed length $l_0=3\,\mathrm{m}$. Released, the body travels down the inclined plane, with friction ($\mu=0.12$), reaching its base with speed $v=0\,\dfrac{\mathrm{m}}{\mathrm{s}}$.

b$_1$) Calculate the value of the longitudinal elastic modulus (Young's modulus), $E$, of the material of the extensible thread and determine the maximum height $h$, above the ground, to which the body will rise back up the inclined plane.

b$_2$) Calculate the value of the friction coefficient $\mu'$ corresponding to the situation in which the body of mass $m$ remains at the base of the inclined plane (in this case, the value of the coefficient of static friction is the same as the value of the coefficient of kinetic friction).

Take $g=9.8\,\dfrac{\mathrm{m}}{\mathrm{s^2}}$.

Problem 3: Motions influenced by an elastic spring ...

The adjacent image shows a body suspended vertically from an elastic spring and in mechanical equilibrium. The elastic spring has spring constant $k=100\,\dfrac{\mathrm{N}}{\mathrm{m}}$, and the mass of the body suspended from the vertical spring is $m=100\,\mathrm{g}$. The body is taken out of the equilibrium position by an additional vertical elongation of the spring by $\Delta\ell_{\max}=5\,\mathrm{mm}$, and then it is released.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2025-1-3-fig1.png

a) Neglecting any dissipative force, write the equation of the second law of classical mechanics for the body of mass $m$ and calculate the maximum speed that the body can reach (justify your answer).

b) It is found that, if $\Delta\ell_{\max}$ is small, then the motion of the body of mass $m=100\,\mathrm{g}$ about the equilibrium position is perfectly comparable with the motion of the projection A, on the OY axis, of a material point with the same mass that moves uniformly on a circle in the horizontal plane XOY (see the adjacent figure). Show that the motion of point A towards the origin of the XOY coordinate system is of the same kind as the motion of the body suspended from the elastic spring in the process of its return to the state of mechanical equilibrium; calculate the angular velocity with which the respective body moves on the circle, considering that the data given above comply with the proposed model.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2025-1-3-fig2.png

c) Calculate, in the context specified in the previous item, the time needed for the body suspended vertically from the spring to go from the position of maximum deformation of the spring to the position of mechanical equilibrium of the body (justify your answer).

d) In the situation in which $\Delta\ell_{\max}$ no longer complies with the model specified above, the solutions resulting from applying the second law of mechanics for the law of motion of the body of mass m and for its velocity are of the form:

$$y(t)=C_1\cdot e^{\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}t}+C_2\cdot e^{-\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}t}-\frac{m\cdot g}{k},\quad\text{and}\quad v(t)=C_1\cdot\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}\cdot e^{\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}t}-C_2\cdot\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}\cdot e^{-\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}t},$$

respectively, where $e$ is an irrational number whose value is $e\simeq2.7$, $C_1$ and $C_2$ are two constants, and the rest of the notation has been specified above. Taking into account the values of the given quantities, calculate the values of the constants $C_1$ and $C_2$.

e) The body of mass $m$ is placed on a horizontal surface on which friction is negligible and is suspended from the elastic spring of constant $k$, as in the adjacent figure. The elastic spring is undeformed in the position of mechanical equilibrium of the body, and in this position it makes the angle $\alpha_0$ with the horizontal direction (see the figure). The body is taken out of the equilibrium position by displacing it to the right, horizontally, by a small distance x, much smaller than the length of the spring in the undeformed state. Determine, in terms of $\alpha_0$, $k$ and $m$, the time needed for the body to reach, after release, the position of mechanical equilibrium.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2025-1-3-fig3.png

Hint: Take $g=10\,\dfrac{\mathrm{m}}{\mathrm{s^2}}$; if you find it useful, you may use in the calculation the approximation $\sqrt{1+x}\simeq1+\dfrac{x}{2}$, valid for $|x|\ll1$.

problems.title: Poppy seed cake
problems.problem:
Problem 1: Poppy seed cake

(10 points)

A. (4.4 points) Ioan wants to make a poppy seed cake for the birthday of his sister, Ana. Because of some eyesight problems, Ioan has to use bifocal glasses, which have two different pairs of lenses mounted in the frame of the glasses. One pair of lenses helps him see objects located at the optimal reading distance, $\delta=250\,\mathrm{mm}$, and the second pair of lenses helps him see clearly objects located at large distances. Without glasses he sees clearly only objects located between the distances $L_{\min}=70\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $L_{\max}=130\,\mathrm{cm}$.

a. Determine the intervals of distances, measured from Ioan's eyes, at which the poppy seeds are located that cannot be clearly distinguished both without glasses and with glasses. Specify the set of values of the distances corresponding to these intervals.

B. (5.6 points) Ana, keen on the art of photography, tries to capture a sharp image of a poppy seed on the cake, using a camera whose objective has convergence (optical power) $C_0=20\,\mathrm{m^{-1}}$. The diameter of the diaphragm of the objective is $D_0=3\,\mathrm{mm}$. The camera records images on the film/sensor under conditions of approximate stigmatism. The maximum diameter of the spot on the film/sensor for which the eye sees the image as sharp is $D=0.1\,\mathrm{mm}$. The objective of the camera is adjusted to focus exactly on the surface of the film/sensor a poppy seed B located at distance $L=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$ from the objective. The Gaussian approximation is used and the objective of the camera is considered to behave as a thin lens.

b. Determine the maximum distance between two poppy seeds B$_1$ and B$_2$ located on the principal optical axis, on either side of the seed B, such that they can be seen sharply in the photograph.

Ana wants to photograph a thin rectangular strip of cake of length $\ell=0.10\,\mathrm{m}$, taking two photographs. The first photograph is taken when the strip of cake is at a distance of $1\,\mathrm{m}$ from the objective, perpendicular to the principal optical axis, and the second photograph when the strip of cake is in a new position with respect to the objective, along the same direction. She notices that the length of the image of the strip of cake in the second photograph is two times smaller than that in the first photograph.

c. Determine the expression of the position with respect to the objective at which the strip of cake is located when Ana takes the second photograph, and specify its value.

Problema 1: Prăjitură cu mac

(10 puncte)

A. (4,4 puncte) Ioan dorește să prepare o prăjitură cu mac pentru ziua surorii sale, Ana. problems.title: Naphthalene and water
problems.problem:
Problem 2: Naphthalene and water

(10 points)

Two right circular cylinders, each of base area S and volume V, are connected by a double piston. The piston can slide without friction and has negligible mass. The whole system can be considered to have negligible heat capacity. The cylinders are fixed on the horizontal surface. Using electrical devices of negligible dimensions, which are not visible in Figure 1, the whole system is kept at a constant temperature T, the same as that of the surroundings.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2025-2-2-fig1.png

Figure 1

In the first cylinder, on the left, there is, in total, a mass $m_1$ of naphthalene ($\mathrm{C_{10}H_8}$), with molar mass $\mu_1$. A part of the mass of naphthalene is in the solid state and the other part is in the form of vapour, at the saturation pressure $p_{s1}$ corresponding to the temperature T. In the second cylinder, on the right, there is water vapour, at a pressure lower than the saturation pressure $p_{s2}$.

Initially the piston is in mechanical equilibrium. Consider that the volume occupied by the solid naphthalene is negligible compared with the volume of the cylinder. Also, assume that the incompressible phases have negligible volume and that the vapours of the substances in the two cylinders obey the ideal gas laws.

a. Determine the amount of water vapour, $\nu_2$, in the second cylinder.

b. Determine the fraction $f$ of the mass of naphthalene that is in solid form.

Problem 3: Projects

(10 points)

A. (3 points) For the project competition "The energy efficiency of the holiday house", Ionuț analysed some problems related to the thermal insulation of the walls of a building. In order to carry out this project, he started by studying the one-dimensional "flow" of heat between two plane and parallel faces of a layer of material, a flow assumed to take place along the direction normal to the two faces.

It is known that the heat flux through a surface is the physical quantity expressed by the amount of heat that crosses that surface in unit time.

The expression of the conduction heat flux through a surface of area $A$, perpendicular to the direction of the flow of heat through a layer of material, is

$$\Phi_{cond}=\kappa\cdot A\cdot\frac{T_M-T_m}{\ell}\qquad(1)$$

In the expression of relation (1), $T_M$ and $T_m$ $(T_M>T_m)$ are the temperatures of the two plane and parallel faces of the layer of material, $\ell$ is the distance between the two faces, and $\kappa$ is the thermal conductivity of the material of the layer under analysis. It is considered that inside the layer of material the temperature decreases linearly from one face to the other.

On the basis of the analogy between the phenomenon of thermal conduction and that of the passage of an electric current through a resistor, one can introduce the quantity

$$\Re_{cond}=\frac{1}{\kappa}\cdot\frac{\ell}{A}\qquad(2)$$

called the thermal resistance for conduction, and one can write the expression of relation (1) in a form similar to Ohm's law for a portion of a circuit without a generator

$$T_M-T_m=\Re_{cond}\cdot\Phi_{cond}\qquad(3)$$

It must also be specified that, because of the phenomenon of convection that appears in the layer of air in thermal contact with the wall, the temperature $T_s$ of the wall is not the same as the temperature $T_f$ of the air. The heat flux from the hot body to the cold body, at the solid–fluid interface, is proportional to the temperature difference between the solid and the fluid and has the expression

$$\Phi_{conv}=h\cdot A\cdot\left|T_s-T_f\right|\qquad(4)$$

where $h$ is a quantity characteristic of the fluid called the convection coefficient, and $A$ is the area of the surface perpendicular to the direction of the flow of heat. In this case, one can define a thermal resistance of convection, at the solid–fluid interface

$$\Re_{conv}=\frac{1}{h\cdot A}\qquad(5)$$

and one can write the expression of relation (4) in a form similar to Ohm's law for a portion of a circuit without a generator.

Ionuț used this knowledge in his project and proposed a simple model, in which each outer wall of the house is built of several successive layers, with plane and parallel faces. Such a wall has, on the side facing the inside of the house, a layer of plaster, applied on the layer of brick. On the other side of the layer of brick there is an insulating layer of polystyrene, on which a new layer of plaster is applied. For simplicity, the convection coefficient of the air in contact with the outer face and with the inner face, respectively, of such a multilayer wall can be considered to have the same value. Ionuț assumed that the temperature of the air in the house has the same value at any point inside it, that the temperature of the air outside the house remains constant and that the two layers of plaster each have the same thickness. For the elaboration of his project, Ionuț used the symbols and the values of the quantities indicated in Table no. 1.

Table no. 1

$$\begin{array}{|l|l|} \hline \text{Thickness of each of the two layers of plaster} & \ell_1=3.00\,\mathrm{cm} \\ \hline \text{Thermal conductivity of plaster} & \kappa_1=0.70\,\mathrm{W\cdot m^{-1}\cdot K^{-1}} \\ \hline \text{Thickness of the brick wall} & \ell_2=25.0\,\mathrm{cm} \\ \hline \text{Thermal conductivity of brick} & \kappa_2=1.60\,\mathrm{W\cdot m^{-1}\cdot K^{-1}} \\ \hline \text{Thickness of the layer of polystyrene} & \ell_3=15.0\,\mathrm{cm} \\ \hline \text{Thermal conductivity of polystyrene} & \kappa_3=0.04\,\mathrm{W\cdot m^{-1}\cdot K^{-1}} \\ \hline \text{Temperature of the air inside the house} & t_{int}=20.0\,^{\circ}\mathrm{C} \\ \hline \text{Temperature of the air outside the house} & t_{ext}=-10.0\,^{\circ}\mathrm{C} \\ \hline \text{Convection coefficient of air} & h=6.00\,\mathrm{W\cdot m^{-2}\cdot K^{-1}} \\ \hline \end{array}$$

In order to evaluate Ionuț's project, use the symbols and the values of the quantities in Table no. 1 and answer the following requirements:

a. Derive the expression of the total thermal resistance between the inside and the outside of the house, corresponding to a surface of area $A$ of the wall of the house, if this surface is perpendicular to the direction of the flow of heat. Calculate the value of the total thermal resistance if the area of the surface is $A=1.00\,\mathrm{m^2}$.

b. Under the condition mentioned in item 1.a., write the expression of the heat flux $\Phi$ that flows from the air in the room through the wall to the air outside the house. Calculate the value of this heat flux.

c. Derive the expressions of the temperatures $t_1$ and $t_2$ of the inner face and of the outer face, respectively, of the wall of the house, under the specified conditions. Calculate the values of these temperatures.

B. (3 points) The project made by Andrei for the same competition concerns the use, for a holiday house, of electrical and thermal energy obtained by converting the energy coming from the Sun. In this project he proposes mounting electric solar panels and thermal solar panels on the roof of the holiday house and aims at estimating the strictly necessary total area of these panels in order to ensure the optimal functioning, from the energy point of view, of this house.

At the location where the holiday house is built, Andrei estimated that the energy received from the Sun, per unit time, per unit normal area of the electric or thermal solar panels is $\kappa=1200\,\mathrm{W\cdot m^{-2}}$.

An electric solar panel is an assembly of solar cells that converts solar energy into electrical energy. For his project, Andrei chose a type of solar cell whose surface exposed to the Sun has the shape of a square of side $\ell_0=2\,\mathrm{cm}$. This type of solar cell is a device equivalent to a battery with electromotive force $E_0=0.48\,\mathrm{V}$ and negligible internal resistance, and it has efficiency $\eta_{el}=24\%$.

A thermal solar panel converts solar energy into thermal energy and has efficiency $\eta_{termic}=48\%$.

According to Andrei's project, the electrical consumers in the house are connected in parallel and operate at a nominal voltage $U=24\,\mathrm{V}$. The holiday house requires an electrical power $P_{el}=1152\,\mathrm{W}$ in each of the $t=12$ hours of the day and, respectively, an electrical power $P_{el}=1152\,\mathrm{W}$ in each of the $t=12$ hours of the night. Electrical energy can be stored during the day, with negligible losses, for consumption at night, but thermal energy cannot be stored. Therefore, for heating during the night, electrical energy is converted, without losses, into thermal energy. For the holiday house, the power required for heating in each of the $t=12$ hours of the day is $P_{termic}=1152\,\mathrm{W}$, and the power required for heating in each of the $t=12$ hours of the night is $P_{termic}=P_{el}=1152\,\mathrm{W}$.

In order to be able to evaluate Andrei's project, use the symbols and the values of the quantities indicated above and answer the following requirements:

d. Determine the way in which the cells of the solar panels should be connected electrically in order to ensure the supply of electrical energy for the holiday house. Derive the value of the number $N$ of solar cells required, according to the specifications of Andrei's project.

e. Taking into account that at night the thermal energy is supplied by electric heating, determine the value of the total area of the surface of the electric and thermal solar panels strictly necessary to be used, according to Andrei's project.

C. (4 points) For a physics project, Claudia analyses the behaviour of a three-dimensional electric circuit in the shape of a right triangular prism when it is supplied at different points. All the edges of the prism are made of straight conductors that have the same electrical resistance $R=150\,\Omega$.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2025-2-3-fig1.png

Figure C1

To begin with, the source of electromotive force is connected between the terminals A and F, as in Figure C1. If the polarity of the source is reversed, the magnitudes of the currents in the figure do not change. Claudia assumes that the value of the current through the source, $I=0.5\,\mathrm{A}$, is known and applies Kirchhoff's laws to determine the value of the current $I_3$ through the edge AF and of the current through the edge BC.

f. Reconstruct Claudia's reasoning and determine the values of the currents $I_3$ and $I_5=I_{BC}$.

Claudia then connects the source between the terminals A and D of the circuit.

g. What is the value of the internal resistance of the source if it delivers maximum power to the circuit?

Claudia joins the nodes A and E, B and D, F and C with straight conductors that have the same electrical resistance as the edges of the prism, as in Figure C2. Claudia first connects the voltage source between the terminals A and F of the circuit and determines the value of the equivalent resistance $R_{AF}$. Then she connects the source between the nodes A and D and determines the value of the equivalent resistance $R_{AD}$.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/roonf-2025-2-3-fig2.png

Figure C2

h. Determine the value of the ratio $\dfrac{R_{AF}}{R_{AD}}$.
